abstract.t: This document describes a deployment model and operational considerations for rate control in Segment Routing over IPv6 (SRv6) network slices. It leverages a token-bucket scheduler to differentiate Committed Information Rate (CIR) and Peak Information Rate (PIR) traffic, and describes how a headend may enforce a rate profile on an SR Policy and adjust the PIR based on network conditions. It addresses the operational trade-off between resource utilization and congestion avoidance in over-committed slice deployments.
